name: Input Snap (test build)
description: Test build: rewinds a few physics frames instead of dying, to check that rewinding works before the auto-correct is built on it.

enabled.name: Rewind instead of dying
enabled.description: When you would die, jump back a few frames and keep playing.

rewind-frames.name: Rewind distance (physics frames)
rewind-frames.description: How far back to jump. 240 frames is one second, so 10 is about 42 ms. Use 40+ while testing so the jump is easy to see.

snapshot-interval.name: Snapshot every N frames
snapshot-interval.description: 1 saves the game every physics frame (most precise, most work). Raise it if the overlay shows high snapshot cost or the game stutters.

max-in-a-row.name: Max rewinds in a row
max-in-a-row.description: If you keep dying straight after a rewind, the real death goes through after this many tries.

show-overlay.name: Show test overlay
show-overlay.description: Bottom-left readout: snapshot cost, number of rewinds, how far back the last one went.
